categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Labeled Tests; adds unit test coverage for deserialization edge cases in src/test/transaction_tests.cpp and src/test/serialize_tests.cpp.
categories.rationale: Adds unit test coverage for truncated CompactSize prefixes and malformed transaction encodings in DecodeHexTx. While it fixes no bug and changes no production behavior, it pins edge-case deserialization error handling discovered via cross-implementation comparison with bitcoin-s.
